library.deleteBookTitle: Delete this book and its audio
library.notice.scannedOcr: This book is scanned images — OCR was used to extract the text, so accuracy may vary.
library.notice.multiColumn: Some multi-column pages were re-read with the accurate layout engine for correct reading order.
library.notice.scannedSkipped: {scope} are scanned images with no text layer and were skipped.
library.notice.scannedSkippedInstall: {scope} are scanned images with no text layer and were skipped — install the Page layout model (Settings → Models) to read them with OCR.
library.notice.undecodable: {scope} use fonts whose text could not be decoded and were skipped.
library.importError.drm: This book is DRM-protected and can't be imported. No partial import was made.
library.importError.scanned: This book is scanned images — install the Page layout model (Settings → Models) to import it with OCR.
library.importError.duplicate: This book is already in your library.
library.importError.open: This file couldn't be opened. It may be corrupted or not a valid PDF.
library.layoutConsequence: Without it, page numbers and running heads are read aloud — roughly 270 per 200 pages in a typical textbook.
library.staleConsequence: This book was read by an older version. Re-reading it also finds the code listings, so they are announced once each instead of prose being replaced by “a code block appears here”. Audio you already made is untouched — re-create it to hear the difference.
library.deleteError.rereading: This book's text is being re-read. Stop that first, then delete it.
library.deleteError.jobActive: An audio job for this book is queued, running or paused. Cancel it first, then delete the book.
library.deleteError.generic: Could not delete this book. It is still in your library.
library.rereadError.alreadyAnalysed: This book was already read with the layout model.
library.rereadError.noLayoutSuite: The layout model is not installed, so re-reading would produce the same text.
library.rereadError.reflowed: This book has no fixed pages, so it has no running heads to remove.
library.rereadError.jobActive: An audio job is queued or running for this book. Let it finish or cancel it, then try again.
library.rereadError.extractionActive: This book's text is already being re-read.
library.rereadError.cancelled: Re-reading stopped. The book kept its earlier text.
library.rereadError.leaseLost: Another re-read took over this book, so this one stopped. The book kept its earlier text.
library.rereadError.claimLost: This re-read lost its claim on the book and stopped. The book kept its earlier text.
library.rereadError.chaptersMoved: Re-reading would move chapter boundaries that saved audio depends on, so it was stopped.
library.rereadError.noBlocks: Re-reading produced no text, so the book kept what it had.
library.rereadError.noBook: This book is no longer in your library.
library.rereadError.scanned: This book is scanned images, so re-reading would repeat the OCR and produce the same text.
library.rereadError.generic: Re-reading failed. The book kept its earlier text.
library.rereadOutcome.mismatch: The layout model read this book, but its regions did not line up with the text, so most running heads are still read aloud. Re-reading again would give the same result.
library.rereadOutcome.notRun: The layout model did not read this book, so the text is unchanged.
library.rereadOutcome.partial: Only part of this book could be re-read, so some running heads are still read aloud. You can try again.
library.rereadOutcome.suiteAbsent: The layout model is not installed, so the text is unchanged.
library.rereadOutcome.failed: The layout model could not read this book, so the text is unchanged.
library.talkHint: Talk with the voice tutor about this book — no cast needed
library.rerenderNeeded: Re-render needed — the audio no longer matches the chapters.
library.sendNone: Finished casts can be sent to your phone — there are none yet
library.layoutEta: This book would take {eta} on your machine.
library.importTradeoffEta: CPU extraction takes {cpuEta}; layout analysis takes {layoutEta} on your machine.
library.laterFromMenu: You can run this later from the book’s menu.
library.rereadEta: This takes {eta} on your machine, and replaces the text this book already has.
library.rereadTradeoffEta: CPU extraction takes {cpuEta}; layout analysis takes {layoutEta} on your machine.
library.emptyHint: Import a PDF or EPUB to get started.
library.step2: Cast it to audio in a voice you pick
library.step3: Listen, follow along, send to your phone
library.noAudioHint: Cast a book to hear it — finished audio lands here.
library.noAudioDetail: Finished casts can be played, followed word by word, or sent to your phone over your own network.
library.unattachedHint: Audio kept after its book or cast was deleted — books, casts and audio are deleted independently.
library.audioDeleteFailed: This audio could not be deleted. {reason}

library.deleteAllPartial.one: {count} file could not be deleted and remains in the library
library.deleteAllPartial.other: {count} files could not be deleted and remain in the library

library.rereadBusy: One book is already being re-read. Let it finish, then try the next one.
library.stopNotYet: This pass is still starting up and cannot be stopped yet. Try again in a moment.
library.castingEmpty: No book is being cast right now.
library.seekDriftHelp: This cast predates exact seeking. Re-render it with the same settings so the highlight stays in step with the voice.
